notes.title: v0.1.9 Patch Notes – June 2, 2025
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Vehicle Collision & Traffic Jam Issue
[/list]
Fixed an issue where certain vehicles were improperly configured, causing chain collisions with the cars ahead and leading to abnormal stops and traffic congestion.

[olist]
[*] Brick-Carrying Animation Bug
[/olist]
Fixed a bug where the brick-carrying animation would not play when the player character was female.

[list]
[*] ₩ Symbol Display Error During Kickboard Payment
[/list]
Resolved an issue where the ₩ (Korean Won) symbol was displayed as a square (□) during kickboard rental payment.

[list]
[*] HP Decrease During Simulation
[/list]
Fixed an issue where the player's HP would rapidly drop to zero during minigame simulation if stamina or hunger was depleted.
HP will no longer decrease during simulation.

[list]
[*] NG Mall Unauthorized Access Bug
[/list]
Fixed a bug where players could crouch through a metal gate and enter an unfinished area of NG Mall. Access to this zone is now blocked.

[list]
[*] Carryover of Funds in New Game+
[/list]
Resolved an issue where money from the first playthrough would carry over into the second.
Starting a new game now properly resets the player's money.

[list]
[*] NPC Positioning Fixes
[/list]
Adjusted NPC placement:

Fixed an issue where an NPC at the police station was standing on a chair instead of sitting.

Corrected the position of an NPC who was floating in the air behind the BBQ restaurant.

[list]
[*] Miscellaneous Fixes
[/list]

Fixed a missing graphic on one of the charcoal objects in the BBQ restaurant.

notes.title: v0.1.8 Patch Notes – June 2, 2025
notes.content:
-Game Freeze Bug Fix
Fixed an issue where the game could freeze after eating food or performing certain actions.

-Prevented Duplicate NPC Relationships
Resolved a bug where NPCs could be added multiple times to the relationship panel.

-Left-Click Input Conflict Fix
Previously, trying to click and drag inventory items while holding food would trigger the eating action instead. This has been fixed — eating/drinking actions no longer activate while the inventory screen is open.

-Audio Glitch After Loading Fixed
Fixed an issue where in-game sounds would play at abnormally high volume right after loading.

-Home Container Positioning Bug Fix
Fixed an issue where items placed in the home container would appear outside of it.

-Shop Purchase Sound Added
Added a sound effect to confirm item purchases in shops.

-Inventory Load Issue Fixed
Fixed a bug where the inventory would not load correctly after loading a saved game.
